title: 第3134章 诸方混战牵制第3133章 乱战血染源海
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
叶馨叶欣的太极图边缘，一道原本被完美中和的圣光余波，因因果线的牵引。
突然与一道佛光残韵产生了诡异的共鸣，爆发出远超预计的冲击，狠狠撞在太极图薄弱处。
让太极图剧烈一晃，叶馨叶欣同时闷哼，气息微乱。
圣耀世与渡心虽也受到波及，但影响较小，立刻抓住机会加强攻势！
而最倒霉的，莫过于血戮海与刹罗灭。
他们潜伏的区域，空间结构突然变得极其不稳定，同时时间流速莫名加快了一瞬！
就是这一瞬的加速与空间紊乱，让他们隐藏的气息泄露了一丝！
而这一丝泄露，恰好被刚刚击退仙临尘，正需要发泄的叶昊，以及一直关注战场，寻找机会的叶凰同时捕捉到！
“两只老鼠，躲得挺深！”叶昊冷哼一声，重瞳锁定血戮海，一道蕴含至尊意志的仙光破空而去！
“正好拿你们试刀！”叶凰长啸，白金神火化作一只神骏的火凰，携带着涅盘新生的霸道意志，扑向刹罗灭！
血戮海与刹罗灭惊怒交加，他们没想到隐藏得这么好还会被精准发现，更被两人同时攻击！
仓促间，血戮海掀起滔天血浪抵挡仙光，刹罗灭则怒吼着挥动战斧劈向火凰。
轰轰——！
血浪被仙光洞穿，血戮海惨叫着倒飞，血河道场再次受损。
火凰与战斧碰撞，爆发出漫天火星，刹罗灭被震得连连后退，战魔之躯上留下焦黑的痕迹。
因无果的因果干涉，虽然让自己受伤，却成功搅动了战局。
让原本相对平衡的几处战团出现了变数，也暴露了血戮海与刹罗灭，可谓一石数鸟。
时溯与空宰见状，知道再斗下去也难有结果，且因无果已受伤，下方战局又生变数。
两人对视一眼，竟默契地同时收手，身影缓缓淡去，重新隐入时空大道本源内，继续观望。
他们的战斗，暂时以平局告终，但都受了些暗伤。

因无果的搅局，如同在沸腾的油锅里又泼了一瓢冷水。
本就混乱的战场，变得更加不可预测。
叶昊与叶凰的突然出手，打乱了血戮海和刹罗灭的恢复计划，也吸引了其他天骄的注意。
妖月璃在炼化完那团混沌能量后，气息恢复了不少，她美眸流转，看到叶凰离开原位去攻击刹罗灭。
而叶昊也被血戮海暂时牵制，叶羽正在为叶君护法……叶家阵营出现了一丝短暂的防御空隙！
“机会！”妖月璃眼中闪过一丝狠色与贪婪。
她的目标，是正在盘膝疗伤，消化剑道感悟的叶君！
若能趁其不备，以噬月神通重创甚至吞噬这位剑道天骄，她的收获将难以估量！
她身影融入月华，悄无声息地朝着叶君靠近，九轮受损的噬月神影被她催动到极致，凝聚成一道几乎无形的月华之刺，瞄准了叶君的后心！
然而，她忘了，叶家并非只有叶羽一人在护法。
就在妖月璃的月华之刺即将触及叶君背心的刹那。
“妖女，敢尔！”
content_en:
At the edge of Ye Xin's Tai Chi diagram, there is a residual wave of holy light that was originally perfectly neutralized, but was pulled by the line of cause and effect.
Suddenly, it resonated strangely with the residual rhyme of Buddha's light, and exploded with an impact far beyond expectations, hitting the weak spot of the Tai Chi diagram hard.
Let the Tai Chi diagram shake violently, and Ye Xin groaned at the same time, her breath slightly confused.
Although Sheng Yaoshi and Du Xin were also affected, the impact was smaller, so they immediately seized the opportunity to strengthen their offensive!
The most unlucky ones are none other than Blood Killing Sea and Sha Luo Mie.
In the area where they were lurking, the spatial structure suddenly became extremely unstable, and at the same time, the flow of time inexplicably accelerated for a moment!
It was this moment of acceleration and spatial chaos that allowed a trace of their hidden aura to leak out!
And this leak happened to be caught at the same time by Ye Hao, who had just defeated Xian Linchen and needed to vent, and Ye Huang, who had been paying attention to the battlefield and looking for opportunities!
"Two mice, hiding quite deep!" Ye Hao snorted coldly, locked his eyes on the sea of ​​blood, and a fairy light containing the supreme will broke through the air!
"Just in time to test the sword with you!" Ye Huang roared, and the platinum divine fire turned into a divine fire phoenix, carrying the domineering will reborn in Nirvana, and rushed towards Sha Luo Mie!
The Sea of ​​Blood and Sha Lua Mie were both frightened and angry. They didn't expect that they would be accurately discovered after hiding so well, and they were attacked by both of them at the same time!
In a hurry, the sea of ​​blood set off a huge wave of blood to resist the immortal light, while Sha Luo Mie roared and swung his battle ax to strike at the fire phoenix.
Boom boom——!
The blood wave was pierced by the fairy light, the sea of ​​blood screamed and flew upside down, and the blood river dojo was damaged again.
The fire phoenix collided with the battle ax, and sparks burst out all over the sky. Sha Lua Mie was shocked and retreated continuously, leaving scorched black marks on the body of the war demon.
Although he was injured due to his fruitless karmic interference, he succeeded in stirring up the battle situation.
It caused changes in several battle groups that were originally relatively balanced, and also exposed the Sea of ​​Blood and Sha Lua Mie. It can be said that killing two birds with one stone.
When Shi Sui and Kong Zai saw this, they knew that if they continued fighting, there would be no result. Moreover, they were already injured due to the fruitless fight, and the battle situation below was changing again.
The two of them looked at each other and stopped their hands at the same time in a tacit understanding. The figures slowly faded away and disappeared into the origin of the time and space avenue again, and continued to watch.
Their battle ended in a draw for the time being, but they both suffered some hidden injuries.
Stirring up the situation to no avail is like pouring another ladle of cold water into a boiling pot of oil.
The already chaotic battlefield has become even more unpredictable.
Ye Hao and Ye Huang's sudden attack disrupted the recovery plans of Xueluhai and Shaluo Mie, and also attracted the attention of other geniuses.
After Yao Yueli refined the chaotic energy, her aura recovered a lot. Her beautiful eyes moved and she saw Ye Huang leaving his position to attack Sha Luo Mie.
Ye Hao was also temporarily restrained by the Sea of ​​Blood, and Ye Yu was protecting Ye Jun... There was a brief defensive gap in the Ye family's camp!
"Opportunity!" A trace of ruthlessness and greed flashed in Yaoyueli's eyes.
Her target is Ye Jun, who is healing from his injuries and digesting his knowledge of swordsmanship!
If she could take advantage of her unpreparedness and use the moon-devouring magical power to severely injure or even devour this prodigy of swordsmanship, her gains would be immeasurable!
Her figure merged into the moonlight and silently approached Ye Jun. The nine-round damaged Moon-devouring Divine Shadow was pushed to the extreme by her, condensing into an almost invisible thorn of moonlight, aiming at Ye Jun's back!
However, she forgot that Ye Yu was not the only one protecting the Ye family.
Just when Yao Yueli's Moonlight Thorn was about to touch Ye Jun's vest.
"Witch, how dare you!"
